title: Best Feasible Conditional Critical Values for a More Powerful Subvector Anderson-Rubin Test
abstract: arXiv:2601.17843v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: For subvector inference in the linear instrumental variables model under homoskedasticity but allowing for weak instruments, Guggenberger, Kleibergen and Mavroeidis (2019) (GKM) propose a conditional subvector Anderson and Rubin (1949) (AR) test that uses data-dependent critical values that adapt to the strength of the parameters not under test. This test has correct size and strictly higher power than the test that uses standard asymptotic chi-square critical values. The subvector AR test is the minimum eigenvalue of a data-dependent matrix. The GKM critical value function conditions on the largest eigenvalue of this matrix. Instead, this paper considers a data-dependent critical value function that conditions on the second-smallest eigenvalue, as this eigenvalue is the appropriate indicator of weak identification. translated_title: 面向更强功效子向量安德森-鲁宾检验的最优可行条件临界值
translated_abstract: 在线性工具变量模型的子向量推断中，在同方差假设下但允许弱工具变量存在时，Guggenberger、Kleibergen和Mavroeidis（2019）（GKM）提出了一种条件子向量安德森-鲁宾（1949）（AR）检验，该检验使用依赖数据的临界值，以适应未被检验参数的强度。该检验具有正确的检验水平，并且比使用标准渐近卡方临界值的检验具有严格更高的功效。子向量AR检验统计量是一个依赖数据的矩阵的最小特征值。GKM的临界值函数以该矩阵的最大特征值为条件。与之不同，本文考虑了一种以第二小特征值为条件的依赖数据的临界值函数，因为该特征值是弱识别程度的适当指标。我们发现GKM的依赖数据的临界值函数同样适用于这种条件化方式，并表明该检验（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出将子向量AR检验的临界值函数以数据依赖矩阵的第二小特征值（即弱识别的适当指标）为条件进行构造，从而得到比GKM检验功效严格更高的子向量安德森-鲁宾检验。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes conditioning the data-dependent critical value function on the second-smallest eigenvalue of the matrix underlying the subvector AR test, which is the appropriate indicator of weak identification, thereby obtaining a strictly more powerful subvector Anderson-Rubin test than GKM's.
